title: Off-site backups: bucket, token and your key
body:
Off-site backups need three things from you. Paste each into its field below: they go straight to the server's key store, and no agent ever sees them.

1. The bucket's name
2. Its access token
3. Your backup key
answer: Saved on the server: BACKUP_BUCKET, BACKUP_TOKEN, BACKUP_KEY. Jobs get the test keys as environment variables (without _TEST_).
